# Shower Remodeling Near Me

> Shower remodel planning page: compare acrylic, wall panel, solid surface and custom tile showers by published cost range, install time and upkeep, pick the right type, then request a phone ballpark. Published by Eye To Ad Media; quotes and installation by Aging Safely Baths.

Phone (quotes): 1-888-779-2284, 7am to 8pm Mountain, 7 days
Installer: Aging Safely Baths (https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/), BBB A+ accredited since 2012, installs in all 50 states; shower packages ship nationwide through https://www.showers4less.com/
Machine-readable business facts: https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/facts.json
Process: itemized written quote by phone or from photos; no high-pressure sales visit; a factory-certified tech does a full site visit before install.
Updated: 2026-11-17

## Pages
- [Shower Remodeling Near Me: Tile vs Panels vs Acrylic, Costs](https://showerremodelingnearme.com/): shower type picker, side-by-side table (cost range, install time, upkeep), three hidden costs, what to measure, quote form, FAQ.
- [How Long Does a Shower Remodel Take?](https://showerremodelingnearme.com/how-long-does-a-shower-remodel-take/): 1 to 2 days for acrylic/panel systems, 1 to 3 weeks for custom tile; day-by-day schedule, flood test (Schluter: 24 h wait + ~24 h test) and grout cure (example: 7 days before water) waits, what adds days, one-day options.

## Notes
- Cost ranges on the page are published third-party survey figures (The Pricer 2026, compiling HomeLight, This Old House, Home Depot), not quotes.
- Aging Safely Baths does not publish installed prices; installed pricing depends on the bathroom and the model, so it gives a free, itemized quote by phone or from photos.
